meta.description: Once a day, read an RSS feed and email an HTML digest. Placeholder URL and SMTP credentials — attach your own before activating.

parameters.content:
## Setup
1. Replace the RSS URL in **Read RSS feed**.
2. Create an SMTP credential in n8n and attach it to **Send digest email** (replace the placeholder).
3. Set From and To addresses.
4. Adjust the schedule if you do not want 07:00 (n8n instance timezone).
5. Activate the workflow only after a successful manual test.

No credentials or secrets are included in this file.

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.count === 0 ? 'Daily RSS digest (no items)' : 'Daily RSS digest: ' + $json.count + ' item(s)' }}
